title: Assam Police Halt Adi Galo Anti-Dam March, Protesters Await Clearance

ai.summary: Assam Police halted the Adi Galo Welfare Society's anti-dam march in Lakhimpur district on November 13, 2026, citing lack of prior administrative intimation, while protesters await clearance to continue their 300-400km journey from Geku village to Itanagar.

facts.claim: Assam Police halted the Adi Galo Welfare Society (AGWS) anti-dam march in Lakhimpur district on Friday, November 13, 2026, citing the absence of prior administrative intimation
facts.quote: Lakhimpur: Assam Police halted the Adi Galo Welfare Society (AGWS) anti-dam march in Lakhimpur district on Friday, November 13, 2026, citing the absence of prior administrative intimation.

facts.claim: The protesters, travelling from Geku village in Arunachal Pradesh towards Itanagar, have paused their 300–400-kilometre journey while awaiting formal administrative clearance
facts.quote: The protesters, travelling from Geku village in Arunachal Pradesh towards Itanagar, have paused their 300–400-kilometre journey while awaiting formal administrative clearance.

facts.claim: Assess Police intercepted the Adi Galo Welfare Society's foot march in Lakhimpur district on Friday, citing the lack of prior administrative intimation about the procession
facts.quote: Assess Police intercepted the Adi Galo Welfare Society's foot march in Lakhimpur district on Friday, citing the lack of prior administrative intimation about the procession.

facts.claim: The marchers had been walking peacefully and had not disrupted public activity
facts.quote: Basar told reporters that the marchers had been walking peacefully and had not disrupted public activity.

facts.claim: The protesters have since remained stationed in Lakhimpur while awaiting the necessary administrative permissions to resume their journey
facts.quote: The protesters have since remained stationed in Lakhimpur while awaiting the necessary administrative permissions to resume their journey.

facts.claim: The AGWS march began on November 4, 2026, from Geku village in Upper Siang district of Arunachal Pradesh
facts.quote: The AGWS march began on November 4, 2026, from Geku village in Upper Siang district of Arunachal Pradesh.

facts.claim: The organisation planned to submit a memorandum to Arunachal Pradesh Chief Minister Pema Khandu in Itanagar, opposing activities associated with the proposed 11,200 MW Siang Upper Multipurpose Project
facts.quote: The organisation planned to submit a memorandum to Arunachal Pradesh Chief Minister Pema Khandu in Itanagar, opposing activities associated with the proposed 11,200 MW Siang Upper Multipurpose Project.

facts.claim: The proposed march covers approximately 300 to 400 kilometres between Geku village and Itanagar
facts.quote: The proposed march covers approximately 300 to 400 kilometres between Geku village and Itanagar.

facts.claim: The protesters crossed into Assam through Ruksin on November 6 after beginning their journey two days earlier
facts.quote: The protesters crossed into Assam through Ruksin on November 6 after beginning their journey two days earlier.

facts.claim: Their scheduled arrival in Itanagar was November 15
facts.quote: Their scheduled arrival in Itanagar was November 15.

ai.background_note: The Adi Galo Welfare Society is opposing the proposed 11,200 MW Siang Upper Multipurpose Project, which involves Pre-Feasibility Report activities and paramilitary deployment in Arunachal Pradesh.
